add_eval_args_fps: add evaluation FPS sync mode argument to an argparse parser for controlling environment frame rate
add_eval_args_render_action_repeat: add render action repeat argument to an argparse parser for repeating actions during evaluation
add_eval_args_no_render: add no render flag argument to an argparse parser to disable environment rendering during evaluation
add_eval_args_policy_index: add policy index argument to an argparse parser for selecting which policy to evaluate in multi-policy training
add_eval_args_continuous_actions_sample: add continuous actions sample argument to an argparse parser for choosing between sampling or mean actions at test time
